title: CD8+调节性T细胞通过T细胞受体定向调控自然上皮内淋巴细胞发育的机制研究
originalTitle: T cell receptors from CD8 regulatory T cells direct the development of natural intraepithelial lymphocytes
summary: Murphy等在bioRxiv发表研究，发现CD8+调节性T细胞的T细胞受体（Ly49+、Helios+）定向调控自然上皮内淋巴细胞（IELs）发育，并揭示Helios并非自然IELs发育所必需的转录因子。

story.title: CD8+ Tregs TCRs调控自然IELs发育，Helios非必需

author: Murphy, S. J. H., Bonner, J., Yao, T., Thakur, C., Bals, J., Yokoyama, W. M., Borcherding, N., Saligrama, N.
